notes: s002 is unrepresented because the ASV writes to God with no determiner; rule 21 forbids leaving a bare to on the article, so the case preposition stays with the noun. Reading the the of the Father as this article's determiner is the competing analysis, but patri is anarthrous and rule 51's anarthrous clause makes that the the noun's helper.
s005 is emptied by hemon under rule 20's first arm, and the genitive's of accordingly stays with kyriou.
